findings.gap: 3317ada5-b347-894e-8c88-110b7b42d58b..76451749-a54f-8579-96f2-dcec19d79026 are sealed with specPath set and no seal.specDocDigest / postSealAmends. Whole-bet acceptance and 520ff720-fc13-8275-b710-f677f8d2efb4 require check-seal + audit to fail on silent Markdown drift, while outOfScope only grandfathers audit to warn until amend/re-seal and never states check-seal behavior for seals lacking an expected doc digest. Shipping 520ff720-fc13-8275-b710-f677f8d2efb4 as written can break dogfood check-seal/audit on four done workstreams.
findings.plainImpact: Turning on plan-doc digests could suddenly fail checks on older sealed workstreams that never got a stamp.
findings.fixProposal: Pin grandfather in pitch + 1f1b46eb-ad28-8870-b46d-9826d55aaa1c + acceptance: if neither seal.specDocDigest nor any postSealAmends.afterDocDigest exists, check-seal skips the doc-byte check (JSON seal check unchanged); audit emits warn (not failOn error) until first amend or re-seal backfills. Doc-drift fail applies only when an expected digest exists. Add a fixture citing 3317ada5-b347-894e-8c88-110b7b42d58b-shaped state.

findings.gap: Pitch 520ff720-fc13-8275-b710-f677f8d2efb4 step 2 says check-seal recomputes the file digest and ‘mismatch on either → fail’ without naming the compare target. Step 3 says amend ‘updates the current expected doc digest pointer’ — easy to mis-implement as rewriting live seal.specDocDigest (forbidden; seals/N.json + seal fields are immutable; postSealAmends are excluded from sealPayload). 1f1b46eb-ad28-8870-b46d-9826d55aaa1c and 520ff720-fc13-8275-b710-f677f8d2efb4 acceptance correctly imply last expected = seal.specDocDigest else latest afterDocDigest, but the pitch prose fights that.
findings.plainImpact: Builders could make every plan amend permanently fail check-seal or corrupt the seal stamp.
findings.fixProposal: Rewrite pitch §2–3: check-seal compares live file sha256 to last expected digest (seal.specDocDigest if no amends, else latest postSealAmends[].afterDocDigest); never mutate seal.specDocDigest after seal; amend only appends postSealAmends. Mirror the same sentence in 1f1b46eb-ad28-8870-b46d-9826d55aaa1c if needed.

findings.gap: Pitch says audit finding severity ‘high enough to fail ledger:audit when policy requires’, but packages/ledger audit findings use severity error|warn with policy.failOn default [error] — not review severities low|moderate|high. Untestable weasel for the gate that makes silent edits CI-blocking.
findings.plainImpact: Silent plan edits might only warn in CI while the team thinks the gate is hard-fail.
findings.fixProposal: State: spec-doc-digest-drift findings use audit severity error (fail under default failOn); grandfather-no-digest uses warn. Name both rule ids in 520ff720-fc13-8275-b710-f677f8d2efb4 acceptance.

findings.gap: workstream amend CLI lacks negatives: refuse unless status is sealed/active/done (post-seal); behavior when file bytes already equal last expected (no-op vs error); how humanConfirmed is set from --by (agents must not forge confirmed amends without a human gate). Required postSealAmends fields are listed but CLI contract is incomplete.
findings.plainImpact: Agents could record fake ‘human confirmed’ plan amends or spam empty amend rows.
findings.fixProposal: Add 520ff720-fc13-8275-b710-f677f8d2efb4 negatives: amend refuses if unsealed; refuse or no-op when after digest equals last expected; humanConfirmed true only with explicit flag or documented human --by policy. Unit fixtures for each.
